questions: In fully visible middle frames, are exactly three pens visible on the white carrier?
Does each pen show a visible black cap-like part at its lower end?
Does any pen show an exposed pointed writing tip where the black cap-like part should be?
Are the three pens parallel and similarly oriented on the carrier?
Are the black cap-like parts on the same end of all three pens?
Is any pen reversed or upside down compared with the other pens?
Is any pen tilted or diagonal compared with the other pens?
Does the carrier move smoothly from LEFT to RIGHT while the pens remain stable relative to it?

question_answers.evidence: In frames 00:04 to 00:09, exactly three pens are clearly visible on the white carrier plate.
All three pens show a black cap-like part at their lower ends.
No pen shows an exposed writing tip; all have the black cap visible.
The two left pens are vertical and parallel, but the rightmost pen is tilted diagonally.
The black cap-like parts are all located at the bottom end of each pen.
No pen is reversed or upside down; all caps are at the bottom.

parsed.reason: The rightmost pen is tilted diagonally compared to the other two vertical pens, constituting a wrong orientation anomaly.
